output.title: Refund policy — subscription cancellation
output.content: You can cancel your subscription at any time from Account Settings > Billing. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period. We do not issue partial refunds for unused days in the current period.

output.title: Refund policy — duplicate charges
output.content: Duplicate charges caused by a billing system error are refunded automatically within 5 business days. No ticket is required, but you're welcome to ask support to confirm a specific refund is in progress.

output.title: Upgrading from Free to Pro plan
output.content: Upgrade from Account Settings > Billing > Change Plan. The Pro plan is billed immediately on a prorated basis for the remainder of your current billing cycle, then at the full rate from the next cycle onward.

**Subject: Re: Cancelling and want a refund for this month**

Thank you for reaching out, and I'm sorry to hear you'd like to cancel your subscription.

I understand you're looking for a refund for the unused portion of your billing period. Unfortunately, according to our refund policy, **we do not issue partial refunds for unused days in the current billing period**. Your subscription will continue to be active and charged through the end of your current billing cycle, regardless of when you cancel.

However, you can cancel your subscription at any time from **Account Settings > Billing**. Once cancelled, your subscription will remain active through the end of your current billing period, and you will not be charged for any future periods.

If you have any questions about this policy or your specific situation, please let me know and I'm happy to help.
